title: Make the delayed-snapshot regression prove same-revision delta admission and classification protection
outcome: The final revision-R orchestrator delta in older_remote_snapshot_does_not_unclassify_a_proxy_after_a_newer_tail currently supplies the same classified row as the preceding owner tail. The test would pass if the per-session delta guard were removed or the whole delta were ignored. Send an unclassified summary at R, make a separate observable orchestrator change, and check that the delta applied while the proxy remains classified in the public projection. Keep the regression's stale, equal and newer snapshot checks.
acceptance: The regression fails if the per-session guard is removed or if the whole revision-R delta is ignored, and still tests the public projection after late, equal and newer snapshots.
